subject.title: feat(runtime): run OpenClaw under Bun runtimes that provide node:sqlite

question: Should OpenClaw experimentally support Bun builds that implement `node:sqlite`, and if so which real, independently verified capability contract should both startup guards enforce?
rationale: The present probe is not documented as available in Bun, while enabling a new application runtime expands the supported-operational surface and changes the startup contract for users.

options.title: Repair the experimental Bun path
options.body: Keep experimental Bun support, but replace the unsupported probe with one verified against the targeted Bun release and add real-runtime coverage for both launcher guards.

options.title: Retain Node-only startup
options.body: Keep the existing Bun rejection until Bun publishes a stable, fully verified runtime contract that OpenClaw can safely support.

options.title: Support only a documented Bun release line
options.body: Adopt an explicitly versioned Bun support policy if a reliable feature probe cannot be implemented without loading application code.

recommendation.title: Repair the experimental Bun path
recommendation.body: Keep experimental Bun support, but replace the unsupported probe with one verified against the targeted Bun release and add real-runtime coverage for both launcher guards.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history connects this contributor to the proposed runtime contract, although current-main history should be consulted before final ownership assignment.
